svg.aria-label: Espressionism architecture: the chat sends each question, its session id and the calculator's values to POST /api/chat, which keeps the conversation in memory, prompts Gemini directly and streams back text plus product cards and calculator fills built by its tools (store search, show_machines, show_store_link, fill_calculator) from the shared store and calculator packages. Cards open the store pages in a new tab; fills update the calculator on the page. In-browser agents use the same store search and calculator tool through WebMCP.
svg.text: A UI and an agent, one source of truth: both share the store and the calculator.
